# SoX: Sound eXchange

**The Swiss Army knife of audio manipulation**

## Description

SoX (Sound eXchange) is a command-line audio processing tool that can:
- Read and write audio files in most popular formats
- Apply effects and transformations to audio
- Combine multiple input sources
- Synthesize audio
- Act as a general purpose audio player (when invoked as `play`)
- Act as a multi-track audio recorder (when invoked as `rec`)
- Query audio file metadata (via the `soxi` command)

SoX is particularly suited to making quick, simple edits and batch processing of audio files.

## Usage

### Basic Syntax

```bash
sox [global-options] [format-options] infile1 \
    [[format-options] infile2] ... [format-options] outfile \
    [effect [effect-options]] ...
```

```bash
play [global-options] [format-options] infile1 \
     [[format-options] infile2] ... [format-options] \
     [effect [effect-options]] ...
```

```bash
rec [global-options] [format-options] outfile \
    [effect [effect-options]] ...
```

### Examples

Convert audio format:
```bash
sox recital.au recital.wav
```

Convert with effects (down-mix to mono, resample, fade, normalize):
```bash
sox recital.au -b 16 recital.wav channels 1 rate 16k fade 3 norm
```

Convert raw/headerless audio to WAV:
```bash
sox -r 16k -e signed -b 8 -c 1 voice-memo.raw voice-memo.wav
```

Adjust audio speed:
```bash
sox slow.aiff fixed.aiff speed 1.027
```

Concatenate audio files:
```bash
sox short.wav long.wav longer.wav
```

Mix audio files:
```bash
sox -m music.mp3 voice.wav mixed.flac
```

Play audio with effects:
```bash
play "The Moonbeams/Greatest/*.ogg" bass +3
```

Synthesize audio (A minor seventh chord):
```bash
play -n -c1 synth sin %-12 sin %-9 sin %-5 sin %-2 fade h 0.1 1 0.1
```

Record audio (30 minutes of stereo):
```bash
rec -c 2 radio.aiff trim 0 30:00
```

## SoXI - Query Audio File Information

The `soxi` command displays metadata from audio file headers:

```bash
soxi [options] infile1 ...
```

### Options

- `-t` - Show detected file-type
- `-r` - Show sample-rate
- `-c` - Show number of channels
- `-s` - Show number of samples
- `-d` - Show duration (hours:minutes:seconds)
- `-D` - Show duration in seconds
- `-b` - Show bits per sample
- `-B` - Show bitrate
- `-p` - Show estimated sample precision
- `-e` - Show audio encoding name
- `-a` - Show file comments/annotations

## Supported Audio Formats

SoX supports a wide variety of audio formats including:

- Raw files (various binary and text formats)
- AIFF/AIFC (Apple/SGI)
- AU (SUN, NeXT)
- CDDA (Compact Disc Digital Audio)
- FLAC
- MP2/MP3
- Ogg Vorbis
- Opus
- WAV/RIFX (Microsoft)
- WavPack
- IRCAM SoundFile
- NIST SPHERE
- VOC (SoundBlaster)
- And many more...

## Effects and Processing

SoX includes numerous audio effects:

### Tone/Filter Effects
- Tone generation and synthesis
- Filters (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, etc.)
- Equalizer effects

### Volume/Dynamics
- Volume adjustment
- Normalization
- Companding/compression
- Gain control
- Fade in/out

### Temporal Effects
- Delay and echo
- Reverb
- Chorus and flanger
- Phaser
- Tremolo

### Editing
- Trim
- Pad
- Silence detection/removal
- Splice
- Reverse

### Analysis
- Statistics
- Spectrograms
- Voice activity detection

### Other
- Rate conversion/resampling
- Channel mixing and remixing
- Dithering
- Format conversion

## Documentation

For complete details on usage, effects, and supported formats, consult the manual pages:
- `man sox` - Main command documentation
- `man soxi` - File information tool documentation
- `man soxformat` - Supported formats and devices
- `man libsox` - Library API documentation

## License

SoX is licensed under the GNU GPL and GNU LGPL.

The `sox` and `soxi` programs are distributed under the GPL, while the library `libsox` 
(in which most of SoX's functionality resides) is dual-licensed. Some optional components 
of libsox are GPL only.

See the LICENSE files for details.

## Project Information

- Website: http://sox.sourceforge.net
- Mailing list: sox-users@lists.sourceforge.net
- Bug reports: sox-devel@lists.sourceforge.net

GLOBAL OPTIONS (gopts) (can be specified at any point before the first effect):

--combine concatenate    Concatenate all input files (default for sox, rec)
--combine sequence       Sequence all input files (default for play)
-D, --no-dither          Don't dither automatically
--dft-min NUM            Minimum size (log2) for DFT processing (default 10)
--effects-file FILENAME  File containing effects and options

-h, --help               Display version number and usage information
--help-effect NAME       Show usage of effect NAME, or NAME=all for all

--no-clobber             Prompt to overwrite output file
-m, --combine mix        Mix multiple input files (instead of concatenating)
--combine mix-power      Mix to equal power (instead of concatenating)
-M, --combine merge      Merge multiple input files (instead of concatenating)
--multi-threaded         Enable parallel effects channels processing
--norm                   Guard (see --guard) & normalise
--play-rate-arg ARG      Default `rate' argument for auto-resample with `play'
--plot gnuplot|octave    Generate script to plot response of filter effect

--replay-gain track|album|off  Default: off (sox, rec), track (play)
-R                       Use default random numbers (same on each run of SoX)
-S, --show-progress      Display progress while processing audio data
--single-threaded        Disable parallel effects channels processing
--temp DIRECTORY         Specify the directory to use for temporary files
-T, --combine multiply   Multiply samples of corresponding channels from all

-V[LEVEL]                Increment or set verbosity level (default 2); levels:

-t|--type FILETYPE       File type of audio
-e|--encoding ENCODING   Set encoding (ENCODING may be one of signed-integer,

-X|--reverse-bits        Encoded bit-order

--comment TEXT           Specify comment text for the output file

        # Remove --i or --info from args and run soxi
        clean_args = [a for a in args if a not in ("--i", "--info")]
        run_soxi(prog_name, clean_args)
        return

    if "--version" in args or "-version" in args:
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2")
        sys.exit(0)

    if not args or "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print(SOX_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)

    if "--help-effect" in args:
        idx = args.index("--help-effect")
        eff_name = args[idx+1] if idx + 1 < len(args) else "all"
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print("Effect usage:\n")
        if eff_name == "trim":
            print("trim {position}\n")
        else:
            print(f"{eff_name}\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    if "--help-format" in args:
        idx = args.index("--help-format")

        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        if fmt_name == "wav":
            print("""Format: wav

Also handles: wavpcm amb
Reads: yes
Writes:
  16-bit Signed Integer PCM (16-bit precision)

            print(f"Format: {fmt_name}")

    # Parse options and files
    combine_mode = "concatenate"
    verbosity = 2
    quiet = False

    class FileOpts:
        def __init__(self):
            self.volume = 1.0
            self.type = None
            self.encoding = None
            self.bits = None
            self.channels = None
            self.rate = None
            self.comment = None

    files_with_opts = [] # list of (filename, FileOpts)
    effects_chain = [] # list of (effect_name, args_list)

    cur_opts = FileOpts()
    idx = 0

    while idx < len(args):
        arg = args[idx]

        # Check for unrecognized option starting with --
        if arg.startswith("--") and arg not in (
            "--buffer", "--clobber", "--combine", "--dft-min", "--effects-file",
            "--guard", "--help", "--help-effect", "--help-format", "--i", "--info",
            "--input-buffer", "--no-clobber", "--multi-threaded", "--norm",
            "--play-rate-arg", "--plot", "--no-show-progress", "--replay-gain",
            "--show-progress", "--single-threaded", "--temp", "--version",
            "--volume", "--type", "--encoding", "--bits", "--channels", "--rate",
            "--compression", "--comment", "--add-comment", "--comment-file", "--no-glob", "--endian"
        ):

            print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
            print(SOX_HELP)
            sys.exit(1)

        # Check if argument is a known effect
        if arg in EFFECT_NAMES:
            # All remaining args are effects
            eff_idx = idx
            while eff_idx < len(args):
                eff_name = args[eff_idx]
                eff_opts = []
                eff_idx += 1
                while eff_idx < len(args) and args[eff_idx] not in EFFECT_NAMES:
                    eff_opts.append(args[eff_idx])
                    eff_idx += 1
                effects_chain.append((eff_name, eff_opts))
            break

        if arg in ("-m", "-M", "-T") or arg == "--combine":
            if arg == "-m":
                combine_mode = "mix"
            elif arg == "-M":
                combine_mode = "merge"
            elif arg == "-T":
                combine_mode = "multiply"
            elif arg == "--combine":

                combine_mode = args[idx] if idx < len(args) else "concatenate"

            quiet = True
        elif arg in ("-S", "--show-progress"):
            quiet = False
        elif arg.startswith("-V"):
            if len(arg) > 2:
                try:
                    verbosity = int(arg[2:])
                except ValueError:
                    verbosity = 3
            else:
                verbosity = 3
        elif arg in ("-v", "--volume"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.volume = float(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-t", "--type"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.type = args[idx]
        elif arg in ("-e", "--encoding"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.encoding = args[idx]
        elif arg in ("-b", "--bits"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.bits = int(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-c", "--channels"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.channels = int(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-r", "--rate"):
            idx += 1
            r_str = args[idx].rstrip('kK')
            cur_opts.rate = int(float(r_str) * (1000 if args[idx].lower().endswith('k') else 1))
        elif arg in ("-C", "--compression"):
            idx += 1
        elif arg in ("--comment", "--add-comment"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.comment = args[idx]
        elif arg.startswith("-"):
            # Format/global option short flags
            if arg in ("-L", "-B", "-x"):
                pass
            else:
                pass
        else:
            files_with_opts.append((arg, cur_opts))
            cur_opts = FileOpts()

        idx += 1

    if not files_with_opts:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL sox: No input filenames specified\n\n")
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print(SOX_HELP)
        sys.exit(1)

    if len(files_with_opts) == 1:
        # Check if first file was synth effect
        if effects_chain and effects_chain[0][0] == "synth":
            # Input is null, output is the 1 specified file
            outfile_name, outfile_opts = files_with_opts[0]
            in_files = [("-n", FileOpts())]
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL sox: No input filenames specified\n\n")
            print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
            print(SOX_HELP)
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        in_files = files_with_opts[:-1]
        outfile_name, outfile_opts = files_with_opts[-1]

    # Load input files
    loaded_inputs = []
    for fname, fopts in in_files:
        try:
            audio = load_audio(
                fname,
                file_type=fopts.type,
                rate=fopts.rate,
                channels=fopts.channels,
                bits=fopts.bits,
                encoding=fopts.encoding,
                volume=fopts.volume
            )
            loaded_inputs.append(audio)
        except FileNotFoundError as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(2)
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    if not loaded_inputs:
        sys.exit(1)

    # Combine input files
    if combine_mode == "mix" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        # Mix input files
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        n_inputs = len(loaded_inputs)
        scale = 1.0 / float(n_inputs)
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                for i in range(min(out_audio.num_frames, audio.num_frames)):
                    out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] = out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] * scale + audio.channels_data[ch][i] * scale
    elif combine_mode == "merge" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        # Merge input files channels
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            out_audio.channels_data.extend(audio.channels_data)
        out_audio.channels = len(out_audio.channels_data)
    elif combine_mode == "multiply" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                for i in range(min(out_audio.num_frames, audio.num_frames)):
                    out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] *= audio.channels_data[ch][i]
    else:
        # Concatenate
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                out_audio.channels_data[ch].extend(audio.channels_data[ch])

    # Apply effect chain
    for eff_name, eff_args in effects_chain:
        out_audio = apply_effect(out_audio, eff_name, eff_args)

    if verbosity >= 3:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} INFO formats: detected file format type `{out_audio.file_type}'\n")

    # Save output file
    try:
        comments = [outfile_opts.comment] if outfile_opts.comment else None
        save_audio(
            out_audio,
            outfile_name,
            file_type=outfile_opts.type,
            rate=outfile_opts.rate,
            channels=outfile_opts.channels,
            bits=outfile_opts.bits,
            encoding=outfile_opts.encoding,
            comments=comments
        )
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF"}

                    verbosity = int(arg[2:])
                except ValueError:
                    verbosity = 3
            else:
                verbosity = 3
        elif arg in ("-v", "--volume"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.volume = float(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-t", "--type"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.type = args[idx]
        elif arg in ("-e", "--encoding"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.encoding = args[idx]
        elif arg in ("-b", "--bits"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.bits = int(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-c", "--channels"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.channels = int(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-r", "--rate"):
            idx += 1
            r_str = args[idx].rstrip('kK')
            cur_opts.rate = int(float(r_str) * (1000 if args[idx].lower().endswith('k') else 1))
        elif arg in ("-C", "--compression"):
            idx += 1
        elif arg in ("--comment", "--add-comment"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.comment = args[idx]
        elif arg.startswith("-"):
            # Format/global option short flags
            if arg in ("-L", "-B", "-x"):
                pass
            else:
                pass
        else:
            files_with_opts.append((arg, cur_opts))
            cur_opts = FileOpts()

        idx += 1

    if not files_with_opts:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL sox: No input filenames specified\n\n")
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print(SOX_HELP)
        sys.exit(1)

    if len(files_with_opts) == 1:
        # Check if first file was synth effect
        if effects_chain and effects_chain[0][0] == "synth":
            # Input is null, output is the 1 specified file
            outfile_name, outfile_opts = files_with_opts[0]
            in_files = [("-n", FileOpts())]
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL sox: No input filenames specified\n\n")
            print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
            print(SOX_HELP)
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        in_files = files_with_opts[:-1]
        outfile_name, outfile_opts = files_with_opts[-1]

    # Load input files
    loaded_inputs = []
    for fname, fopts in in_files:
        try:
            audio = load_audio(
                fname,
                file_type=fopts.type,
                rate=fopts.rate,
                channels=fopts.channels,
                bits=fopts.bits,
                encoding=fopts.encoding,
                volume=fopts.volume
            )
            loaded_inputs.append(audio)
        except FileNotFoundError as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(2)
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    if not loaded_inputs:
        sys.exit(1)

    # Combine input files
    if combine_mode == "mix" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        # Mix input files
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        n_inputs = len(loaded_inputs)
        scale = 1.0 / float(n_inputs)
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                for i in range(min(out_audio.num_frames, audio.num_frames)):
                    out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] = out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] * scale + audio.channels_data[ch][i] * scale
    elif combine_mode == "merge" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        # Merge input files channels
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            out_audio.channels_data.extend(audio.channels_data)
        out_audio.channels = len(out_audio.channels_data)
    elif combine_mode == "multiply" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                for i in range(min(out_audio.num_frames, audio.num_frames)):
                    out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] *= audio.channels_data[ch][i]
    else:
        # Concatenate
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                out_audio.channels_data[ch].extend(audio.channels_data[ch])

    # Apply effect chain
    for eff_name, eff_args in effects_chain:
        out_audio = apply_effect(out_audio, eff_name, eff_args)

    if verbosity >= 3:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} INFO formats: detected file format type `{out_audio.file_type}'\n")

    # Save output file
    try:
        comments = [outfile_opts.comment] if outfile_opts.comment else None
        save_audio(
            out_audio,
            outfile_name,
            file_type=outfile_opts.type,
            rate=outfile_opts.rate,
            channels=outfile_opts.channels,
            bits=outfile_opts.bits,
            encoding=outfile_opts.encoding,
            comments=comments
        )
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF"}

EFFECT_NAMES = {

    "channels", "compand", "contrast", "dcshift", "deemph", "delay", "dither", "divide+",

    "swap", "synth", "tempo", "treble", "tremolo", "trim", "upsample", "vad", "vol"
}

SPECIAL FILENAMES (infile, outfile):

-n, --null               Use the `null' file handler; e.g. with synth effect
-p, --sox-pipe           Alias for `-t sox -'

SPECIAL FILENAMES (infile only):
"|program [options] ..." Pipe input from external program (where supported)
http://server/file       Use the given URL as input file (where supported)

GLOBAL OPTIONS (gopts) (can be specified at any point before the first effect):
--buffer BYTES           Set the size of all processing buffers (default 8192)
--clobber                Don't prompt to overwrite output file (default)
--combine concatenate    Concatenate all input files (default for sox, rec)
--combine sequence       Sequence all input files (default for play)
-D, --no-dither          Don't dither automatically
--dft-min NUM            Minimum size (log2) for DFT processing (default 10)
--effects-file FILENAME  File containing effects and options
-G, --guard              Use temporary files to guard against clipping
-h, --help               Display version number and usage information
--help-effect NAME       Show usage of effect NAME, or NAME=all for all
--help-format NAME       Show info on format NAME, or NAME=all for all
--i, --info              Behave as soxi(1)
--input-buffer BYTES     Override the input buffer size (default: as --buffer)
--no-clobber             Prompt to overwrite output file
-m, --combine mix        Mix multiple input files (instead of concatenating)
--combine mix-power      Mix to equal power (instead of concatenating)
-M, --combine merge      Merge multiple input files (instead of concatenating)
--multi-threaded         Enable parallel effects channels processing
--norm                   Guard (see --guard) & normalise
--play-rate-arg ARG      Default `rate' argument for auto-resample with `play'
--plot gnuplot|octave    Generate script to plot response of filter effect
-q, --no-show-progress   Run in quiet mode; opposite of -S
--replay-gain track|album|off  Default: off (sox, rec), track (play)
-R                       Use default random numbers (same on each run of SoX)
-S, --show-progress      Display progress while processing audio data
--single-threaded        Disable parallel effects channels processing
--temp DIRECTORY         Specify the directory to use for temporary files
-T, --combine multiply   Multiply samples of corresponding channels from all
                         input files (instead of concatenating)
--version                Display version number of SoX and exit
-V[LEVEL]                Increment or set verbosity level (default 2); levels:
                           1: failure messages
                           2: warnings
                           3: details of processing
                           4-6: increasing levels of debug messages
FORMAT OPTIONS (fopts):
Input file format options need only be supplied for files that are headerless.
Output files will have the same format as the input file where possible and not
overridden by any of various means including providing output format options.

-v|--volume FACTOR       Input file volume adjustment factor (real number)
--ignore-length          Ignore input file length given in header; read to EOF
-t|--type FILETYPE       File type of audio
-e|--encoding ENCODING   Set encoding (ENCODING may be one of signed-integer,
                         unsigned-integer, floating-point, mu-law, a-law,
                         ima-adpcm, ms-adpcm, gsm-full-rate)
-b|--bits BITS           Encoded sample size in bits
-N|--reverse-nibbles     Encoded nibble-order
-X|--reverse-bits        Encoded bit-order
--endian little|big|swap Encoded byte-order; swap means opposite to default
-L/-B/-x                 Short options for the above
-c|--channels CHANNELS   Number of channels of audio data; e.g. 2 = stereo
-r|--rate RATE           Sample rate of audio
-C|--compression FACTOR  Compression factor for output format
--add-comment TEXT       Append output file comment
--comment TEXT           Specify comment text for the output file
--comment-file FILENAME  File containing comment text for the output file
--no-glob                Don't `glob' wildcard match the following filename

AUDIO FILE FORMATS: 8svx aif aifc aiff aiffc al amb au avr cdda cdr cvs cvsd cvu dat dvms f32 f4 f64 f8 fssd gsrt hcom htk ima ircam la lpc lpc10 lu maud nist prc raw s1 s16 s2 s24 s3 s32 s4 s8 sb sf sl sln smp snd sndr sndt sou sox sph sw txw u1 u16 u2 u24 u3 u32 u4 u8 ub ul uw vms voc vox wav wavpcm wve xa
PLAYLIST FORMATS: m3u pls
AUDIO DEVICE DRIVERS:

EFFECTS: allpass band bandpass bandreject bass bend biquad chorus channels compand contrast dcshift deemph delay dither divide+ downsample earwax echo echos equalizer fade fir firfit+ flanger gain highpass hilbert input# loudness lowpass mcompand noiseprof noisered norm oops output# overdrive pad phaser pitch rate remix repeat reverb reverse riaa silence sinc speed splice stat stats stretch swap synth tempo treble tremolo trim upsample vad vol
  * Deprecated effect    + Experimental effect    # LibSoX-only effect"""

SPECIAL_FILENAMES = {"-", "-n", "--null", "-d", "--default-device", "-p", "--sox-pipe"}

def main():
    prog_name = os.path.basename(sys.argv[0])
    args = sys.argv[1:]

    if prog_name == "soxi":
        run_soxi(prog_name, args)
        return

    if "--i" in args or "--info" in args:
        clean_args = [a for a in args if a not in ("--i", "--info")]
        run_soxi(prog_name, clean_args)
        return

    if "--version" in args or "-version" in args:
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2")
        sys.exit(0)

    if not args or "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print(SOX_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)

    if "--help-effect" in args:
        idx = args.index("--help-effect")
        eff_name = args[idx+1] if idx + 1 < len(args) else "all"
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print("Effect usage:\n")
        if eff_name == "trim":
            print("trim {position}\n")
        else:
            print(f"{eff_name}\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    if "--help-format" in args:
        idx = args.index("--help-format")
        fmt_name = args[idx+1] if idx + 1 < len(args) else "all"
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        if fmt_name == "wav":
            print("""Format: wav
Description: Microsoft audio format
Also handles: wavpcm amb
Reads: yes
Writes:
  16-bit Signed Integer PCM (16-bit precision)
  24-bit Signed Integer PCM (24-bit precision)
  32-bit Signed Integer PCM (32-bit precision)
   8-bit Unsigned Integer PCM (8-bit precision)
   8-bit u-law (14-bit precision)
   8-bit A-law (13-bit precision)
   4-bit MS ADPCM (14-bit precision)
   4-bit IMA ADPCM (13-bit precision)
  32-bit Floating Point PCM (25-bit precision)
  64-bit Floating Point PCM (54-bit precision)""")
        else:
            print(f"Format: {fmt_name}")
        sys.exit(1)

    combine_mode = "concatenate"
    verbosity = 2
    quiet = False

    class FileOpts:
        def __init__(self):
            self.volume = 1.0
            self.type = None
            self.encoding = None
            self.bits = None
            self.channels = None
            self.rate = None
            self.comment = None

    files_with_opts = []
    effects_chain = []

    cur_opts = FileOpts()
    idx = 0

    while idx < len(args):
        arg = args[idx]

        # Check for unrecognized option starting with --
        if arg.startswith("--") and arg not in (
            "--buffer", "--clobber", "--combine", "--dft-min", "--effects-file",
            "--guard", "--help", "--help-effect", "--help-format", "--i", "--info",
            "--input-buffer", "--no-clobber", "--multi-threaded", "--norm",
            "--play-rate-arg", "--plot", "--no-show-progress", "--replay-gain",
            "--show-progress", "--single-threaded", "--temp", "--version",
            "--volume", "--type", "--encoding", "--bits", "--channels", "--rate",
            "--compression", "--comment", "--add-comment", "--comment-file", "--no-glob", "--endian", "--null", "--default-device", "--sox-pipe"
        ):
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} WARN getopt: parameter not recognized from `{arg}'\n")
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL sox: invalid option\n\n")
            print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
            print(SOX_HELP)
            sys.exit(1)

        # Check if argument is a known effect (if we already have at least 1 input file and 1 output file, or synth with 1 output file)
        if len(files_with_opts) >= 2 and arg in EFFECT_NAMES:
            eff_idx = idx
            while eff_idx < len(args):
                eff_name = args[eff_idx]
                eff_opts = []
                eff_idx += 1
                while eff_idx < len(args) and args[eff_idx] not in EFFECT_NAMES:
                    eff_opts.append(args[eff_idx])
                    eff_idx += 1
                effects_chain.append((eff_name, eff_opts))
            break

        if arg in ("-m", "-M", "-T") or arg == "--combine":
            if arg == "-m":
                combine_mode = "mix"
            elif arg == "-M":
                combine_mode = "merge"
            elif arg == "-T":
                combine_mode = "multiply"
            elif arg == "--combine":
                idx += 1
                combine_mode = args[idx] if idx < len(args) else "concatenate"
        elif arg in ("-q", "--no-show-progress"):
            quiet = True
        elif arg in ("-S", "--show-progress"):
            quiet = False
        elif arg.startswith("-V"):
            if len(arg) > 2:
                try:
                    verbosity = int(arg[2:])
                except ValueError:
                    verbosity = 3
            else:
                verbosity = 3
        elif arg in ("-v", "--volume"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.volume = float(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-t", "--type"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.type = args[idx]
        elif arg in ("-e", "--encoding"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.encoding = args[idx]
        elif arg in ("-b", "--bits"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.bits = int(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-c", "--channels"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.channels = int(args[idx])
        elif arg in ("-r", "--rate"):
            idx += 1
            r_str = args[idx].rstrip('kK')
            cur_opts.rate = int(float(r_str) * (1000 if args[idx].lower().endswith('k') else 1))
        elif arg in ("-C", "--compression"):
            idx += 1
        elif arg in ("--comment", "--add-comment"):
            idx += 1
            cur_opts.comment = args[idx]
        elif arg in SPECIAL_FILENAMES or not arg.startswith("-"):
            files_with_opts.append((arg, cur_opts))
            cur_opts = FileOpts()

        idx += 1

    if not files_with_opts:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL sox: No input filenames specified\n\n")
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print(SOX_HELP)
        sys.exit(1)

    if len(files_with_opts) == 1:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL sox: No input filenames specified\n\n")
        print(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        print(SOX_HELP)
        sys.exit(1)

    in_files = files_with_opts[:-1]
    outfile_name, outfile_opts = files_with_opts[-1]

    loaded_inputs = []
    for fname, fopts in in_files:
        try:
            audio = load_audio(
                fname,
                file_type=fopts.type,
                rate=fopts.rate,
                channels=fopts.channels,
                bits=fopts.bits,
                encoding=fopts.encoding,
                volume=fopts.volume
            )
            loaded_inputs.append(audio)
        except FileNotFoundError as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(2)
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    if not loaded_inputs:
        sys.exit(1)

    if combine_mode == "mix" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        n_inputs = len(loaded_inputs)
        scale = 1.0 / float(n_inputs)
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                for i in range(min(out_audio.num_frames, audio.num_frames)):
                    out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] = out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] * scale + audio.channels_data[ch][i] * scale
    elif combine_mode == "merge" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            out_audio.channels_data.extend(audio.channels_data)
        out_audio.channels = len(out_audio.channels_data)
    elif combine_mode == "multiply" and len(loaded_inputs) > 1:
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                for i in range(min(out_audio.num_frames, audio.num_frames)):
                    out_audio.channels_data[ch][i] *= audio.channels_data[ch][i]
    else:
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                out_audio.channels_data[ch].extend(audio.channels_data[ch])

    for eff_name, eff_args in effects_chain:
        out_audio = apply_effect(out_audio, eff_name, eff_args)

    if verbosity >= 3:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} INFO formats: detected file format type `{out_audio.file_type}'\n")

    try:
        comments = [outfile_opts.comment] if outfile_opts.comment else None
        save_audio(
            out_audio,
            outfile_name,
            file_type=outfile_opts.type,
            rate=outfile_opts.rate,
            channels=outfile_opts.channels,
            bits=outfile_opts.bits,
            encoding=outfile_opts.encoding,
            comments=comments
        )
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF"}

    else:
        out_audio = loaded_inputs[0]
        for audio in loaded_inputs[1:]:
            for ch in range(min(out_audio.channels, audio.channels)):
                out_audio.channels_data[ch].extend(audio.channels_data[ch])

    for eff_name, eff_args in effects_chain:
        out_audio = apply_effect(out_audio, eff_name, eff_args)

    if verbosity >= 3:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name}:      SoX v14.4.2\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} INFO formats: detected file format type `{out_audio.file_type}'\n")

    try:
        comments = [outfile_opts.comment] if outfile_opts.comment else None
        save_audio(
            out_audio,
            outfile_name,
            file_type=outfile_opts.type,
            rate=outfile_opts.rate,
            channels=outfile_opts.channels,
            bits=outfile_opts.bits,
            encoding=outfile_opts.encoding,
            comments=comments
        )
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_name} FAIL formats: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)
